marta: quick Q — when using the JS SDK with service account impersonation and project-scoped audience, our streaming reconnects are getting 401s. anyone seen this?

devin: which audience are you setting? SDK expects the OIDC `aud` to be the token exchange URL (full), not just a project id.

marta: i'm setting `aud: 'projects/12345'` via `client.auth.setAudience()` — naive. logs show:

```
[stream] auth error: invalid_audience — expected https://sts.redwood.ai/token
```

samira: yep that's the root cause. for SA impersonation the audience must match the STS audience. either set `aud` to `https://sts.redwood.ai/token` or use the SDK impersonation helper so it constructs the right audience automatically.

marta: can you paste a minimal patch?

devin: here's a minimal fix in JS — prime the impersonation exchange with the correct audience:

```js
await client.auth.impersonate({
  target: 'svc-analytics@myorg.iam.gserviceaccount.com',
  lifetime: 3600,
  audience: 'https://sts.redwood.ai/token'
});
// then open the streaming connection
```

matt: also watch token cache TTL. if you set lifetime > 1h some runtimes won't refresh on reconnect. keep lifetime = 3600 and enable `autoRefresh: true` in SDK options.

marta: ok testing. if it still fails on reconnect, any workaround besides changing audience?

samira: workaround: force a token exchange right before opening the stream: `await client.auth.fetchToken()` to prime the cache. or pass explicit `authHeaders` to the streaming call so reconnects use the newest token.

marta: tests green after the change, reconnects are OK. thanks!
